content.value: The Gartner Research Intelligence Platform replaces a local Flask/single-file application with a cloud-native, collaborative research platform deployed on Google Kubernetes Engine. All access is gated by Google Workspace SSO via GCP Identity-Aware Proxy — zero custom auth code required.

items: Build and publish research schemas via a UI-driven schema builder
Execute AI-assisted research through configurable agent tasks with model selection
Collaborate in real time — scores, excerpts, and vendor data shared across all analysts
Work offline via PouchDB selective sync to IndexedDB
Access and cite Gartner research, external reports, and scraped data with full audit trail

    A(["Analyst Browser\nGET https://research.gartner.com"]) --> B{"IAP cookie\nvalid?"}
    B -->|No| C["Redirect to\naccounts.google.com"]
    C --> D{"@gartner.com\naccount?"}
    D -->|Yes| E["Issue IAP cookie"]
    D -->|No| F["403 Forbidden"]

    B -->|Yes| H["Validate JWT signature"]
    H --> G
    G --> API["Fastify API\n(verified identity)"]
    API --> RA{User role?}
    RA -->|all-analysts| P1["Read schemas + vendors\nCreate annotations\nRun agent tasks"]
    RA -->|senior-analysts| P2["All above + Publish schemas\nApprove scores\nManage references"]
    RA -->|platform-admins| P3["All above + Manage CouchDB\nView audit logs\nConfigure agent models"]

Roles are controlled via Google Groups mapped to IAP Access Levels. No custom session tokens or JWT signing — GCP handles all identity. Fastify middleware extracts the verified email from X-Goog-Authenticated-User-Email and resolves group membership for RBAC.

content.value: Sync uses CouchDB's filtered replication with Mango selectors. PouchDB.replicate() pulls on app load, then live: true keeps a continuous replication open. On reconnect after offline, PouchDB.sync() pushes queued local writes to CouchDB and pulls remote changes down — conflict resolution uses last-write-wins with timestamp comparison.
